title: The book returned
starting_code:
# Find the book in your hands with `find_item` and the word "book", and keep it in a variable.

# Go up a step into the hall, and right along it to Eldra.

# Give her the book with `give` and the variable.
hints: `find_item` with the word "book" gives the book you carry; keep it in a variable.
Go up a step, then right along the hall, until Eldra is right beside you.
Use `give` with the variable you kept the book in.
intro: The book is in your hands, and Eldra floats at the other end of the hall. Take it to her.
outro: Eldra holds her book again, and thanks you with all her heart.
learned: Now you know that a variable lives in its own program, that `find_item` finds what you carry, and that `give` hands a thing to whoever stands beside you.
